text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото is on a morning jog through
the
shopping district when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Argh!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
She loses her footing and goes tumbling.
Looking
back, she sees a pair of legs
sticking out
underneath a parked truck.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! Trainer, it's an emergency!
Look,
someone has passed out. C-call an
ambulance!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Now, hold on a minute! Nobody here is
in any
danger! I'm just trying to find out
if this thing
needs servicing.
text_block_list.name: Truck Driver

text_block_list.text:
Oh... Well, that's a relief. I'm glad you're
not
experiencing any problems.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Well, actually, I've got a huge problem
on my
hands. My truck's broken down,
and I can't make
any deliveries. I'm
supposed to bring this meat
over to
Tracen Academy...
text_block_list.name: Truck Driver

text_block_list.text:
Huh, to the academy? But if today's
lunch has no
meat... that would be a
disaster!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
However, finding a replacement vehicle
will take
time. And looking at the sheer
amount of food,
calling in a taxi won't
work either.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Um, would it be okay if I carried all the
meat
instead?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Since I'm an Umamusume, that should
mean I'm
pretty strong... And my running
is getting better
too...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Ah, I might slip up... But, I promise to do
my best
to make it in time!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: What makes you want to help so bad?

text_block_list.text:
...Well the other day, I had an accident
at the
cafeteria. I dropped my food and
caused such a
mess...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
But, instead of getting angry... everyone
treated
me with such kindness. And yet,
I haven't done
anything in return... it's so
pathetic!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I want to do whatever I can to make up
for that!
Please let me help!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
...All right! If you must insist, then I'll
leave it to
you!
text_block_list.name: Truck Driver

text_block_list.text:
And so, Мэйсё Дото takes charge of
bringing all
the containers to Tracen
Academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll be on my way... Huh? Is that
you, Mr.
Tanuki?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Where did you... Wait, are you going to
find a
shortcut for me?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Yip! Yip!
text_block_list.name: Tanuki

text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... It's so heavy... But I can't stop now...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Woof! Woof, woof, woof!
text_block_list.name: Dog

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Don't hate me, little doggy, but
you're
blocking the way... I'll just scoot
around you!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm slippin—eeeeek! I can't stop
when I'm on a
hiiillll!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Phew... I managed to make it.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Well done to you, Doto! Tazuna told me

everything. I was quite surprised when I
heard it,
but you really did make the
trip.
text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady

text_block_list.text: Oh... you're from the cafeteria!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm very, very grateful for your help,
Doto. We
should be able to make the
lunch menu just as
planned! Please, eat
up to your heart's content!
text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady

text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Those stairs were tough on my legs... I should take a break... All right, let's put the meat down...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Donk! Tumble, tumble!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Noooo, waaaait! Please don't fall down
the
staaairs!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was r-really heavy... But I
managed
to make it.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Happiness is here, for the meat has
arrived! Yum,
yum, I've been waiting for
you, meat—I mean,
Doto!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: ...Huh? F-Fukukitaru?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: The meat's here, ma'am!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Well done to you, Doto! Tazuna
told me
everything. I was quite surprised
when I heard it,
but you really did make
the trip.
text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady

text_block_list.text:
I also wish to show my gratitude, Doto!
Today's
lucky katsu curry is back on the
menu thanks to
you!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Oh, really? Ehehe, I'm so glad.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I'm very, very grateful for your help,
Doto. We
should be able to make the
lunch menu just as
planned! Please, eat
up to your heart's content!
text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady

text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Uuugh, this is so heavy... I need to be careful so I don't go running into a tree...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Waagh!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Ouch, I fell over... My legs are getting so
sluggish.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... I guess this was too much to
tackle for a
klutz like me...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: I'm so, so, sorry! I'm always making the same mistakes... Sniff! Uuugh...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Don't be so glum. You look exhausted
too...
Here, eat lots of food and get your
energy back!
text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady

text_block_list.text:
But... I've got to try my best... That's all
I'm
capable of.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Phew... I... managed to make it.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Good work, Мэйсё Дото. The delivery
driver
told me everything. You've done
well to bring this
all here.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! President, you're b-being too
nice.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Believe me. The whole student body
would be
singing your praises, knowing
what you've done.
Allow me to speak on
their behalf. Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
She's right, you know. Thank you so
much! We
should be able to make the
lunch menu just as
planned. Please eat
up to your heart's content!
text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady

text_block_list.text: Oh, you t-two... Ngh... Ohhh...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay! Lunch is going to be great!
Maybe I
should go for the katsu curry.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you so much! Ohhh, I'm glad I
did my
beeeest!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I'm so glad... I was able to repay

everyone's kindness.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
